methodology.scope: Actual unchanged app capture, separate original retained JSON parser, independent frame and legacy reconstruction; synchronous synthetic states only
methodology.budget: Original128MiB/300000nodes/depth32 unchanged; native matrix measures depth and node counterexamples. Exact128MiB UTF8 tests are separate unit evidence.
methodology.javascript: Unsupported live JS objects are separated from ordinary JSON. Legacy getter/toJSON calls are measured; adapter must call neither.
methodology.protection: Production keeps original capture. Diagnostic data is not a fallback implementation, candidate, source adoption, import or confirmation authority.
methodology.limits: No full-input equivalence, production integration,4/8 capacity improvement,full browser-suite rerun,timing or memory claim. Transaction readiness is NOT_TESTED.
